changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Vistas de alimentacion de los filtros de sala, oficina y categoria (REQ-103 / REQ-159)
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_filtro_sala AS SELECT s.room_id, s.room_code, s.room_name, s.office_id, o.office_name, CASE WHEN s.is_active = 'N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS es_inactivo FROM cat_sala s JOIN cat_oficina o ON o.office_id = s.office_id WHERE s.is_active = 'Y' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM incidencia i WHERE i.room_id = s.room_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_filtro_oficina AS SELECT o.office_id, o.office_code, o.office_name, o.city, CASE WHEN o.is_active = 'N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS es_inactivo FROM cat_oficina o WHERE o.is_active = 'Y' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM incidencia i JOIN cat_sala s ON s.room_id = i.room_id WHERE s.office_id = o.office_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_filtro_categoria AS SELECT c.category_id, c.category_code, c.category_name, c.display_order, CASE WHEN c.is_active = 'N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS es_inactivo FROM cat_categoria_incidencia c WHERE c.is_active = 'Y' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM incidencia i WHERE i.category_id = c.category_id)

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Vista de recuento agregado por oficina, sala y categoria (REQ-104 / AC-CLAS-05)
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_recuento_incidencias AS SELECT CAST('OFFICE' AS VARCHAR2(10 CHAR)) AS group_type, o.office_id AS group_id, CAST(o.office_name AS VARCHAR2(80 CHAR)) AS group_name, CASE WHEN o.is_active = 'N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS es_inactivo, COUNT(i.incident_id) AS incident_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN i.status = 'ABIERTA' THEN 1 END) AS incident_count_abierta, COUNT(CASE WHEN i.status = 'EN_CURSO' THEN 1 END) AS incident_count_en_curso, COUNT(CASE WHEN i.status = 'RESUELTA' THEN 1 END) AS incident_count_resuelta, COUNT(CASE WHEN i.status = 'CERRADA' THEN 1 END) AS incident_count_cerrada, MIN(i.created_at) AS primera_incidencia_at, MAX(i.created_at) AS ultima_incidencia_at FROM cat_oficina o LEFT JOIN cat_sala s ON s.office_id = o.office_id LEFT JOIN incidencia i ON i.room_id = s.room_id GROUP BY o.office_id, o.office_name, o.is_active UNION ALL SELECT CAST('ROOM' AS VARCHAR2(10 CHAR)), s.room_id, CAST(s.room_name AS VARCHAR2(80 CHAR)), CASE WHEN s.is_active = 'N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, COUNT(i.incident_id), COUNT(CASE WHEN i.status = 'ABIERTA' THEN 1 END), COUNT(CASE WHEN i.status = 'EN_CURSO' THEN 1 END), COUNT(CASE WHEN i.status = 'RESUELTA' THEN 1 END), COUNT(CASE WHEN i.status = 'CERRADA' THEN 1 END), MIN(i.created_at), MAX(i.created_at) FROM cat_sala s LEFT JOIN incidencia i ON i.room_id = s.room_id GROUP BY s.room_id, s.room_name, s.is_active UNION ALL SELECT CAST('CATEGORY' AS VARCHAR2(10 CHAR)), c.category_id, CAST(c.category_name AS VARCHAR2(80 CHAR)), CASE WHEN c.is_active = 'N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, COUNT(i.incident_id), COUNT(CASE WHEN i.status = 'ABIERTA' THEN 1 END), COUNT(CASE WHEN i.status = 'EN_CURSO' THEN 1 END), COUNT(CASE WHEN i.status = 'RESUELTA' THEN 1 END), COUNT(CASE WHEN i.status = 'CERRADA' THEN 1 END), MIN(i.created_at), MAX(i.created_at) FROM cat_categoria_incidencia c LEFT JOIN incidencia i ON i.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, c.is_active
